meta.title: feat: Support llm-based message summarization by introducing Transformer mechanism
meta.body_summary: Add transformer architecture for processing tool outputs before LLM consumption; implement llm_summarize transformer with fast secondary models to summarize lengthy outputs, global config flags, tool-level config, and backward compatibility.

perf_labels.notes: Large PR (5,974 lines) adding LLM summarization transformer; closed after moshemorad CHANGES_REQUESTED (design, scope, missing evidence) and manual test logs showing mixed summarization effectiveness.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: The PR is large (5,981 changed lines across 32 files), mostly consisting of new test and infrastructure code. It represents a significant feature addition rather than a small-step perf improvement. It was closed without merge after a CHANGES_REQUESTED review, matching the outcome for a complex, insufficiently justified performance change.

review_details.concern_detail: moshemorad requested not to apply transformers globally by default, questioned recreation of transformers each invocation, suggested using Pydantic for validation, pointed out single-transformer-type limitation in merging, and flagged that summarized output could be larger than original; mainred suggested terminology improvements in documentation and CLI flags; numerous bot comments flagged code style nits.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduced context usage and cost by summarizing large tool outputs with a fast secondary model.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after CHANGES_REQUESTED review with no follow-up addressing design concerns and mixed summarization results.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced a large, functionally working feature but failed to align with maintainer design preferences for configuration and performance evidence; the addition needed more rigorous proof of benefits and design refinement.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer moshemorad reviewed transformer design, questioning global auto-enabling and per-call creation; mainred reviewed documentation and configuration naming.
detection_detail.manual_testing: Author nilo19 provided manual POC logs showing summarization output sizes, including a case where summary was larger.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Manual test logs give examples but not a reproducible benchmark; mixed results.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without merge after CHANGES_REQUESTED were not addressed; no fix-in-PR cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Added a complete transformer framework (base, registry, validation, LLMSummarizeTransformer) and integrated it into the tool execution pipeline. New global config options --fast-model and --summarize-threshold added to CLI and env. Updated YAML toolset definitions to include transformer configs. Added extensive documentation (docs/transformers.md) and 2000+ lines of test coverage.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The majority of line additions are in test files covering transformers, config merging, and integration pipelines.
change_trajectory: Single large commit (412a0b4) introduced all changes.
Two force pushes followed (8a2df19, 412a0b4) possibly rebasing or squashing.
Multiple bot reviews (coderabbitai) with nitpick suggestions and potential code issues.
Author provided manual test logs and an inquiry about summarization quality.
Maintainer moshemorad submitted CHANGES_REQUESTED reviewing design, scope, and performance; other maintainer mainred added documentation comments.
No further commits addressing review; PR closed without merge.

review_signals.summary: Multiple inline comments suggesting code simplifications, type checking improvements, unused variable removal, and style fixes across many test and core files.

Suggested renaming 'summarize-threshold' to 'summarize-threshold', clarifying default prompt, questioning summarization example for node-specific queries, and recommending explicit help text for fast_model.

CHANGES_REQUESTED: Requested not enabling transformers globally by default, questioned per-call transformer recreation, suggested Pydantic configs, noted merging limitation of single transformer type, and asked about cases with no data after transformers.
review_signals.action_taken: PR closed without addressing these design concerns.

review_signals.summary: Flagged an undefined variable 'enabled_toolsets' in toolset_manager.py (potentially a real bug).

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by nilo19 (Claude_Code) with a large feature adding summarization transformers.
Immediate bot reviews (coderabbitai) provided walkthrough, nits, and flagged a potential bug.
Author force-pushed and commented twice: offering to split if hard to review, and linking related issue.
Two days later, author shared manual test logs and raised a concern about summaries being larger than original.
Maintainer mainred provided brief documentation comments; maintainer moshemorad performed a thorough design review and submitted CHANGES_REQUESTED.
No follow-up commits; PR eventually closed without merge.
